findings.detection_method: Source inspection and finite combinatorial construction; a billions-of-path runtime was not executed.
findings.limits: The history count is algebraically represented by multiplicities, not an executed-test count or a formal proof of generic replay correctness.
findings.observed: Initial decision_sufficiency.replay_certificate expanded every distinct observation-label history independently, including labels with identical semantic support.
findings.repair: Replay merges histories having the same fixed world, remaining experiment set, and compatible-world set; exact multiplicities and cost extrema are retained. A one-million unique replay-state cap returns an explicit incomplete result.

no_other_failure_claim: No false accept, false reject, pixel mismatch, leakage counterexample, or protocol failure was found in the completed independent development audit. Later robotics audit results are recorded separately.
role: author/evaluator source review; no model run
